comments.content:
We need a "Has ID Card" access level to put on doors and such (on top of
the new access-based ID system).

One of the big problems that occur from this is that there's no way to hold
people on the starting shuttle before the round begins; there's no common
access level that everyone shares.

Instead of "Has ID Card" can simply be "Is Human" or "access_public_spaces"
or something (in case you want to lock a staff member into his office to
make him work but give him no access to any other public doors?)

All sorts of implementations and ideas around this.. but we need *something*
maybe an "Is SS13 Staff" access level? That way it would block Syndicate cards.
I made all doors not open before the game begins. Simpler.
